releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.3.6 (Build 73):
• Zero Cross-User Contamination: Strict tenant isolation across local cache, Firestore auto-healing, and Outings ensuring complete privacy between user accounts.
• Drive Live Upload Ticker: Active continuous progress indicator showing real-time upload percentage from 25% through completion.
• Folder Palette & Accent Matching: Added Burgundy (#9F1239) and curated jewel tones with file icons dynamically inheriting their parent folder accent.
• Reader & Interface Polish: Streamlined file inspection view, removed redundant buttons for spacious mobile layout, and perfected modal backdrops.
• Timely Event Notifications: Optimized exact alarm scheduling with reminders fixed 20 mins before events and immediate starting alerts.
